landing.heroTitle: All your prescriptions in one place, forever
landing.heroSub: Snap a photo of any prescription and keep it safe. Get reminded when it's time for medicine, appointments, or checkups. Always free.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to manage your health
landing.featuresSub: Simple, powerful tools to organize your medical records and never miss a dose.
landing.feat1Desc: Snap a picture of any prescription or report. No typing required. We store it safely.
landing.feat2Desc: See all your prescriptions, reports, and investigations in a beautiful chronological timeline.
landing.feat3Desc: Never miss a dose. Set daily reminders for medicines with custom schedules and notifications.
landing.feat4Desc: Quickly find any prescription by doctor name, hospital, diagnosis, or medicine name.
landing.feat5Desc: Use in English, Bengali, Spanish, or French. Switch anytime from settings.
landing.feat6Desc: Your health data stays on your phone. Login with just your phone number. No passwords.
landing.howTitle: Get started in under a minute
landing.step1Desc: Enter your phone number and verify with a one-time code. No passwords needed.
landing.step2Desc: Take a photo of any paper prescription or report. Add doctor details and medicines.
landing.step3Desc: All your medical history organized automatically by date. Searchable anytime.
landing.step4Desc: Set reminders for medicines, appointments, and follow-ups. We'll notify you.
landing.ctaSub: Join thousands who trust MedPrescription to keep their medical records safe and accessible.
landing.footer: © 2026 MedPrescription. Your health, your data, your control.
